about: The keepers of the hidden watershed, the creatures a player meets at drains. Every keeper is a model of the pack Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius (CC0), repainted by tools/art. A keeper says nothing about the condition of the drain it sits on and is no claim that a real animal lives there. The part a keeper keeps is fiction that names a real part of the system. Which keeper lives at a drain follows from the drain, the day and the week alone, so every player meets the same one. The timing says how a keeper behaves in a meeting, in seconds. Hover is how high above the grate a keeper that flies stays.

keepers.name: Frog
keepers.tell: It crouches before it hops. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Sits on grates all over town.
keepers.joke: It winds up for a huge jump, hops a hand's width and looks delighted.
keepers.credit: Frog from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Mushnub
keepers.tell: It yawns before it bounces. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Bounces along the gutters of quiet streets.
keepers.joke: It bounces as if the street were a drum and it the only one who hears the music.
keepers.credit: Mushnub from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Puddle
keepers.keeps: keeper of the opening in the kerb
keepers.tell: It gapes before it bounces. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Sits where the kerb opens, in every part of town.
keepers.joke: It is mostly water and entirely sure of itself.
keepers.credit: Green Blob from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Glub
keepers.tell: It rears back before it darts. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Hovers over a drain here and there, never for long.
keepers.joke: It hovers with great dignity and then forgets which way it was going.
keepers.credit: Glub from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Pigeon
keepers.tell: It pecks at the air before it flutters off. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Struts about on a drain here and there.
keepers.joke: It walks as if it owned the street and startles at its own shadow.
keepers.credit: Pigeon from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Fish
keepers.tell: It snaps at the air before it flops over. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Far from the brook, and not bothered at all.
keepers.returning: The one with the grin is back.
keepers.joke: It has never seen the brook and tells everybody about it.
keepers.credit: Fish from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Dino
keepers.tell: It crouches before it leaps, and now and then it only pretends. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Seen only now and then. Your detector may pick it up.
keepers.returning: The little one with the big teeth is back.
keepers.joke: It practises looking fierce and waves at everybody anyway.
keepers.credit: Dino from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Goleling
keepers.tell: It rears back before it darts, and now and then it only pretends. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Seen only now and then. Your detector may pick it up.
keepers.joke: It guards the dark places and is a little afraid of them.
keepers.credit: Goleling from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Dragon
keepers.tell: It rears back before it darts, and it pretends often. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Comes to town for a week now and then. Look for its light.
keepers.joke: It arrives with great ceremony and leaves when it rains.
keepers.credit: Dragon from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted

keepers.name: Bunny
keepers.tell: It crouches before it leaps, and it pretends often. Throw to where it will land.
keepers.hint: Comes to town for a week now and then. Look for its light.
keepers.joke: It carries its carrot everywhere and has never taken a bite.
keepers.credit: Bunny from Ultimate Monsters by Quaternius, CC0, repainted
